papers.title: The embryonic cell lineage of the nematode Caenorhabditis elegans
papers.excerpt: Tracking single-cell lineages across thousands of generations creates immense memory overhead due to repeated storage of identical early ancestral paths. Cell line storage bottlenecks can be formulated as a prefix-redundancy problem requiring deduplication.
